text:
Alex: FYI I spun up hyperanchor-1b on staging (float32) and an int8 quant variant for a quick cold-start smoke. ran ~5k queries from the shortquery holdout.
Priya: Nice — any recall@k numbers? also which index and kNN library did you use? :eyes:
Marco: Quick paste from the smoke run:
```
Model            recall@1  recall@5  recall@10  avg_latency_ms
hyperanchor-1b   0.642     0.815     0.872      34.2
hyperanchor-1b-int8 0.628 0.799     0.856      22.7  # quant reduced latency but small recall dip
index: hnswlib, ef_search=64, M=32, metric=cosine
```
Sasha: UMAP + kmeans on the same embed set shows tighter clusters for float32 in topical cohorts. silhouette dropped ~0.03 with int8. not huge but noticeable for some small cohorts.
Alex: thanks. can we check whether the recall loss is concentrated on short queries (<6 tokens) or on long-tail topics?
Marco: ran stratified by query length:
```
short (<6):  recall@1: float32=0.58  int8=0.50
medium:       recall@1: float32=0.67  int8=0.66
long:         recall@1: float32=0.69  int8=0.68
```
Marco: so short queries take the hit. likely quant noise near low-dim signatures.
Priya: could be K-scale sensitivity. want to try per-channel quant or clamp? also try increasing ef_search to 128 to see if some drop is from index retrieval.
Alex: good ideas. Sasha, can you rerun cluster silhouette but with normalized embeddings (L2) + light whitening? curious if that helps the short query collapse.
Sasha: on it — queueing now. ETA ~20m. will post UMAP plots.
eval-bot: automated-eval summary uploaded -> https://internal/redwood/runs/1752468899 (contains per-cohort recall, UMAP images, sample failure pairs) :white_check_mark:
Priya: for reproducibility, please include the exact quant config: per-tensor vs per-channel, clipping strategy, seed. Marco: current config is int8 per-tensor symmetric, clip=none, seed=42. changing to per-channel next.
Alex: next steps: 1) Marco: rerun with per-channel int8 + clamp, 2) Marco: also try ef_search=128 and log recall/latency tradeoff, 3) Sasha: post normalized-silhouette and UMAP, 4) Priya: add a short-query focused evaluation bucket (5k queries) and include qualitative failure pairs. we'll reconvene if recall@1 for short queries remains >0.07 down vs float32.
Priya: small ask — label any runs that change index params in the run name so we can correlate.
Marco: will do. logging commands I ran:
```
# run embed smoke
python -m eval.run_embed_smoke --model hyperanchor-1b --quant none --index hnswlib --ef_search 64 --seed 42 --out run_1752468899_float32.json
python -m eval.run_embed_smoke --model hyperanchor-1b --quant int8-per-tensor --index hnswlib --ef_search 64 --seed 42 --out run_1752468899_int8pt.json
```
Alex: great. if per-channel narrows the gap, we can consider int8-per-channel as our recommended quant recipe for this model. otherwise fallback: use mixed-precision for short-query route. :thumbsup:
Sasha: normalized UMAPs posted — looks like some topical microclusters remerge after whitening. will attach before/after images in the run.
Marco: upload incoming with per-channel run now. should have numbers in ~15m.
Priya: thanks all. quick note — add top-5 failure pairs to the regression alert set so Optimize can surface it if future runs regress.
Alex: agreed. adding ticket to track followups.
Marco: results: per-channel int8 narrows short-query recall@1 gap from 0.08 -> 0.03, latency 24.1 ms. will push full report.
Alex: solid. leaving this thread open, will close when we've updated the onboarding doc with recommended quant config and the Optimize rule.
